use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
fn encode(value: &Value) -> String {
    match value {
        Value::Null => "N".into(),
        Value::Boolean(true) => "T".into(),
        Value::Boolean(false) => "F".into(),
        Value::Text(text) => format!("S{text}"),
        Value::Number { coefficient, scale } => format!("D{coefficient},{scale}"),
        Value::Record(fields) => format!(
            "R{}",
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| format!("{k}:{}", encode(v)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("|")
        ),
        _ => panic!("unexpected date result"),
    }
}
#[test]
fn tables_match_java_results_and_policy_errors() {
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in include_str!("table_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let (input, expected) = line.split_once('\t').unwrap();
        let value = if input == "null" {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            let parts: Vec<_> = input.split('.').collect();
            let coefficient = parts.concat();
            Value::Number {
                coefficient,
                scale: parts.get(1).map_or(0, |s| s.len() as i32),
            }
        };
        // Canonical coefficient grammar excludes leading zeros.
        let value = match value {
            Value::Number { coefficient, scale } if coefficient.starts_with('0') => Value::Number {
                coefficient: if coefficient.bytes().all(|c| c == b'0') {
                    "0".into()
                } else {
                    coefficient.trim_start_matches('0').into()
                },
                scale,
            },
            other => other,
        };
        let actual = evaluate(&BTreeMap::from([(
            ("urn:rust-proof:tables", "input"),
            value,
        )]));
        if expected == "ERROR" {
            assert!(actual.is_err(), "{line}");
        } else {
            let results = actual.unwrap();
            let actual = results
                .iter()
                .map(|((_, id), value)| format!("{id}={}", encode(value)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(";");
            assert_eq!(actual, expected, "{line}");
        }
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 12);
}
